_comment: Single source of geometry for both the CadQuery oracle and the SOLIDWORKS authoring scripts. Values tagged provisional_design are designer choices under design_then_inspect and must not reach cad/roboracer/parameters.csv.

clamp_engagement.basis: 1.5 x OD; above the rejected 0.75 x OD collar, below the 1.65 x OD catalogue width

bore_diameter.basis: slip fit on tube OD before clamping

slot_width.basis: split gap allowing the clamp to close on the tube

slot_bottom_y.basis: runs to the bore centreline so the slot intersects the bore rather than meeting it tangentially; a tangent slot is degenerate and SOLIDWORKS auto-relations perturb the tangent corner

clamp_bolt_diameter.basis: M6 clearance, DIN 912 / ISO 4762 per spec Part 2

clamp_bolt_z.basis: two bolts distributed along the 30 mm engagement

blocked_not_modelled.clamp_bolt_pitch: measurement - deck bolt pattern omitted from the clamp block
blocked_not_modelled.actual_load_height: measurement - Part 4 load feature not modelled
blocked_not_modelled.root_rotation_station_spacing: design_then_inspect, chosen 40.0 mm, but Part 4 not modelled this pass
